name: SRM Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, SRM Energy Ltd is in the business of generation of power[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SRMEL (formerly Hitkari Fibres Ltd) is a part of the Spice Energy Group. It is a Special Purpose Vehicle formed when SRM Energy Private Ltd. was merged with Hitkari Fibres Ltd to facilitate fund raising and resource mobilization. It was engaged to develop and implement power projects

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
